title: Uncertainty and Business-Aware Remaining Useful Life Estimation for Semiconductor Manufacturing
abstract: arXiv:2609.22160v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Semiconductor manufacturing relies on tightly interconnected components, so early identification of the assets most likely to fail is essential to prevent a single breakdown from disrupting the entire production pipeline. Maintenance planning must therefore balance unexpected failures against prematurely interrupted operating life. We present a Predictive Maintenance (PdM) framework combining Deep Learning (DL) sequence models and Simoultaneous Quantile Regression (SQR)   for uncertainty-aware Remaining Useful Life (RUL) estimation and risk-aware maintenance decisions. translated_title: 面向半导体制造的不确定性与业务感知的剩余使用寿命估计
translated_abstract: 半导体制造依赖于紧密互连的组件，因此尽早识别最可能发生故障的资产对于防止单一故障扰乱整个生产流水线至关重要。因此，维护规划必须在意外故障与过早中断运行寿命之间取得平衡。我们提出了一个预测性维护（PdM）框架，该框架结合了深度学习（DL）序列模型与同时分位数回归（SQR），用于不确定性感知的剩余使用寿命（RUL）估计和风险感知的维护决策。我们在2018年PHM数据挑战赛（PHM18）的离子铣削数据上，使用预测指标和业务指标——意外中断（UB）、未利用寿命（UL）以及成本加权目标——对多种架构进行了比较，其中包括基于状态空间模型（SSM）的架构。对角状态空间模型（S4D）在各分位数上提供了最佳的剩余使用寿命（RUL）估计。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合深度学习序列模型与同时分位数回归的预测性维护框架，在半导体制造场景中实现了不确定性感知的剩余使用寿命估计和风险感知的维护决策，并通过对意外中断、未利用寿命等业务指标的评估发现对角状态空间模型（S4D）表现最佳。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a predictive maintenance framework combining deep learning sequence models with simultaneous quantile regression for uncertainty-aware remaining useful life estimation and risk-aware maintenance decisions in semiconductor manufacturing, showing that Diagonal State Spaces (S4D) deliver the best RUL estimates across quantiles when evaluated with business metrics.
